items.text: Today we're sharing the changelog for a smaller patch, releasing tomorrow, October 22nd, across all platforms.

This patch will focus on further texture optimisations for various pieces of rolling stock, changes to the London Overground Mildmay Line Route Add-On in preparation for the Expansion, and the release of the TSW7 PC Editor.
As with last week’s patch, these changes reduce the overall texture memory for the individual locos or wagons, improving performance and potentially reducing the chance of blurry textures.

Please note that the impact might vary from rolling stock to rolling stock, and that blurry textures might still occur, despite these changes. We continue to work on further improvements and will share more news on this soon.
Alongside this update, we’re releasing the TSW 7 PC Editor. We know many of you have been patiently waiting for it, and we’d like to thank you for bearing with us while we prepared it for release.

This patch also introduces changes to the London Overground Mildmay Line Route Add-On, along with the release of the Mildmay Line Richmond Extension. This extension is a free upgrade for owners of the Mildmay Line, and in addition to five new stations and a new endpoint in Richmond, it introduces several changes and improvements to the base route.
Finally, in addition to the above, this patch also introduces a few minor changes to the core game, Tri-Rail Miami and Nürnberg – Würzburg.
The patch will be live from 9 am UTC/10 am BST - please note that updates typically load quickly, but in some cases may take up to 24 hours to release across each platform.

Following from this update, we’re currently looking at the next patch from the week starting September 21st, and then each week afterwards, to give us plenty of opportunities to address any issues you’re sharing with our teams.
Some notable issues that are under investigation from our teams that you’ve shared:
Some areas around Nürnberg of lower performance and low FPS
Simple controls HUD elements and safety system acknowledgement
Some reports of issues with profile importing
Freight Hauler situations leading players to getting soft locked
Camera movement on controllers can feel sluggish at times
Cars crossing some barriers across Tri-Rail Florida incorrectly
AI conductor doors not interacting as expected on Class 331/333
Investigating if we're able to support a darker UI menu option
Of course, these are only some of the common mentions, but certainly we’re taking in a huge wealth of feedback and currently folding much more into upcoming updates.
Thank you all, please keep sharing your feedback in our channels, and we can’t wait to celebrate the full launch!

items.text: Good afternoon everyone,

Thank you for all the feedback you've been submitting so far - today we have a hotfix rolling out across all platforms that will include key fixes for AI Conductor to prevent crashes we've seen when using multiple locomotives across Nürnberg to Würzburg and Tri-Rail Florida.
Please note that updates typically load quickly, but in some cases may take up to 24-hours to release across each platform.
Update Changelog
Resolved an issue where AI Conductor was causing a crash with the BR 440, FP40PH-3, and GP49 locos when stopping at a station.
Fixed an issue where AI Conductor was causing a crash when set to 'Realistic' in the RE10 (58205) service on Nürnberg to Würzburg.
Fixed an issue where AI Conductor set to ‘Realistic’ was managing door operation on the BR 442 Talent 2 where it shouldn’t.
Thank you for your patience – we’re continuing work on additional issues raised from feedback for a larger update planned alongside launch on September 15th.
